newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: One killed, 10 hurt in Bangladesh gunbattle.
newsitem.headline: One killed, 10 hurt in Bangladesh gunbattle.

text.p: One man was shot dead and 10 were wounded in a gunbattle in Bangladesh's Cox's Bazar resort town on Saturday between student supporters of the ruling Awami League and opposition Jamaat-e-Islami, police said.
The battle was a sequel to long-running enmity between the two groups, police told reporters without giving details.
Cox's Bazar residents said police foiled an attempt by the Islamic students to barricade a highway linking the resort to Chittagong port city 160 km (100 miles) away.
